motivation: Seed-8600 capability ladder (capability_benchmark_analysis_20260830): all evaluative resolution lies outside the lambda=1 envelope, frontier capability tracks recency-weighted frontier exposure, and the equal-split s4 mixture (25% frontier mass, h6000 AUC[1,2] 0.817) lost to fixed (0.925) with no in-envelope dividend. The scalar gap controller anti-gated seed-randomly (2/6 cells, zero guard trips) and is abandoned. The one combination never tested: SUPPORT past lambda=1 (the fixed_150 lever, P1 in the MaxRL/PLR memo ranking) with FRONTIER MASS preserved (75% of envs at the 1.5x frontier) plus a thin retention tail over the lower doses (expand-don't-replace). fixed_u150 is that arm: open-loop fixed mode, controller inert, so no signal can evacuate the frontier.

design.allow_extrapolation: fixed-mode only; controller config stays in [0,1]

mixture.assignment: seeded permutation (anchor_seed = training seed), observer env in the top stratum, tail filled in permutation order

design.training_clamps: clamp_physical after every extrapolated apply (top stratum) and clamp_params_physical on every extrapolated tail stratum; recorded in curriculum jsonl

evaluation.instrument: main-repo clamped evaluator, eval_seed = 8700 + seed_index, identical to capability_benchmark_analysis_20260830
evaluation.baseline_cells: existing seed-8600 campaign receipts: fixed AUC[1,2] 0.925 / phys_150 0.924 / phys_175 0.891 / phys_200 0.820 / lat_50ms 1.000; lucid_rg 0.908; s4_h6000 0.817; off 0.584

design.queue_position: first (prior queue dead after the 2026-08-31 13:11 reboot; margin/fixed_150/PLR arms deferred by explicit direction)

hypotheses.H_U1_support_with_tail: fixed_u150 success exceeds fixed by >= 3 pts averaged over phys_150/phys_175/phys_200. Seed 8600 is screening-grade (one seed, point estimate); the directional claim requires >= 2/3 seeds after confirmatory runs.
hypotheses.H_U2_no_nominal_price: fixed_u150 in-envelope AUC (phys_000..phys_100) within 1 pt of fixed (0.9988).
hypotheses.H_U3_latency_frontier: fixed_u150 >= 0.99 success at lat_40ms and lat_50ms (its trained delay support reaches 60 ms; fixed sits at 1.000 on both).
hypotheses.H_U4_manipulation_check: curriculum_state tace section records stratum_sizes [37,37,37,37,36,36,36,768] and the 8 stratum lambdas; curriculum jsonl rows record allow_extrapolation and physical_clamp; the run trained with --max-delay 12. If any is absent, the arm did not train the intended mixture and every cell is void, reported as an implementation failure.

decision_rule: H_U1 pass -> support extension survives the retention tail: expand-don't-replace with preserved frontier mass is the capability recipe; queue seeds 8601/8602, and run pure fixed_150 later only to separate the support lever from the tail. H_U1 fail while H_U2 holds -> either capability saturates at the envelope or the 25% tail dilutes the support dose; disambiguate with pure fixed_150 before any further mixture work. fixed_u150 below fixed by > 2 pts at the frontier -> the tail costs frontier capability at this scale and the mixture needs frontier mass >= fixed's.
comparability_caveats: fixed_u150 installs the cohort-dispatch machinery (8 strata) while campaign fixed trained without dispatchers; the top stratum samples the event manager's own lambda-scaled params (set_stratum None), the designed byte-identical frontier path.
single-seed screening: every contrast against the baseline is a point estimate on checkpoint seed 8600 / eval seed 8700.
